title: pilea solandri
intro: Pilea solandri, commonly known as the Nepali cabbage or Nepalese boxwood, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Pilea solandri include its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and triterpenoids. However, the exact bioactive constituents of Pilea solandri have not been extensively studied, and further research is needed to confirm its therapeutic potential.
